FIELDS.NAME: Heritage Leather Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Heritage Leather Co. specializes in the retail of high-quality leather goods and luggage, offering a curated selection that includes handbags, backpacks, wallets, and travel accessories. Our operations focus on delivering exceptional craftsmanship and outstanding customer service in a welcoming store environment located in Springfield, IL. We prioritize effective inventory management and employ a comprehensive program to safeguard our merchandise. In addition to our physical retail presence, we have developed an online sales platform to cater to our customers’ preferences for convenient shopping options, supplemented by strong cybersecurity measures to protect customer data. We strive for compliance with all relevant product safety regulations and maintain a comprehensive training program for our employees to uphold best practices in business operations. This multifaceted approach allows us to thrive in the competitive leather goods market while ensuring a secure and enjoyable shopping experience for our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses from theft at the retail location on 02/15/2023, amounting to $3,000.00, currently under investigation. Additionally, a water damage incident caused by a burst pipe on 07/10/2023, resulting in $2,000.00 in repairs, fully resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Sunday 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, Class B, UL listed, one-hour fire rating
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with live monitoring, security cameras with remote access, and regular security audits conducted quarterly.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Heritage Leather Co. carries Workers' Compensation insurance, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and providing coverage for employees in case of work-related injuries.

This allows us to offer a comprehensive range of services to our customers beyond retail sales.

FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Heritage Leather Co. has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong focus on compliance and employee training to prevent such issues.

The company prioritizes fire safety and conducts regular inspections to maintain a secure environment for its customers and employees.
